title: Paired devices
description: The device registry (F1c B6, design D5): each paired device is an owner-authenticator (the device-signature provider of .stella/owner-auth.json) that signs every owner action with its Ed25519 key, bound to a nonce and expiry. Pairing and revoking are owner writes of this row through stella-apply.py (identity-critical: the owner key and the typed phrase). bin/devices.py list|check.

id.description: The device id the device signs (device_id of its proofs).

global_id.description: The record's global id: a lower-case version 4 UUID, unique across every data file (product rule 14). The record's old id stays its alias: every read that takes an entry id accepts either.

install_id.description: The UUID of the install that made the record (its .stella/install.json); a record moved from another install keeps it.

public_key.description: The device's Ed25519 public key, PEM (SubjectPublicKeyInfo); the private key never leaves the device. devices.py check refuses any other key type.

revoked_at.description: Set once to revoke the device (one place): any proof it signs is then refused (STL-OWN-812). null while paired.
